task_title: Widen mcp.test.ts 5s vitest timeout under fleet load
task_criteria: tests/mcp.test.ts per-test 5000ms timeout raised to >=15000ms (and any sibling 5s test timeouts in that file); npx vitest run tests/mcp.test.ts exits 0

items.criterion: tests/mcp.test.ts per-test 5000ms timeout raised to >=15000ms (and any sibling 5s test timeouts in that file); npx vitest run tests/mcp.test.ts exits 0
items.detail: No timeout change exists. `grep -nE "5000|5_000|timeout|15000|15_000" tests/mcp.test.ts` returns exactly one hit — tests/mcp.test.ts:66 `expect(DEFAULT_MCP_CONFIG.limits?.queryTimeoutMs).toBe(5000);` — which is a config-value assertion, not a test timeout. There are no per-test timeout arguments anywhere in the 407-line file (`grep -nE "it\(|test\(" tests/mcp.test.ts | grep -E "[0-9]{4,}"` → no matches), so there is no 5000ms per-test timeout to raise and no sibling 5s timeouts either. `git log --oneline -- tests/mcp.test.ts` shows the last change was 0ed92385 (DF-SPECLANG-4-R4); the HEAD commit 1354cc85 touches only .coding-hermes/board/{events,tasks}.jsonl. The board record for DF-SPECLANG-018 is still `"status":"in_progress"` with acceptance criteria demanding an explicit generous testTimeout at tests/mcp.test.ts:184 — nothing was implemented. The run half does hold: `npx vitest run tests/mcp.test.ts` → EXIT_CODE=0, "Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 33 passed (33)", but it passes only because of the pre-existing global vitest.config.ts:27 `testTimeout: 30_000` (added under QA-SPECLANG-4), not because of any work in this task.
